core-js, 55,838 B on the diary-main page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (134 packages, 539 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
